description: Shared Renovate preset: automerge patch, PR minor, major behind dashboard approval.

packageRules.description: Patch updates: automerge (merges directly unless branch protection requires checks).
Minor updates: open a PR for review.
Major updates: only after ticking the checkbox on the Dependency Dashboard issue.
Private-feed packages are disabled by default; enable per-repo with hostRules + an encrypted Azure Artifacts token.
